test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: general
question: Volume of a cuboid is 4800 cm³. If the height of this cuboid is 20 cm, then what will be the area of the base of cuboid ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of base = Volume ÷ Height

Area of base = 4800 ÷ 20

Area of base = 240 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 240 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of the cuboid = 4800 cm³

Height of the cuboid = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

Volume of a cuboid = Area of base × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b518b8f804223cf64972b5e982d5c5ea0013d10297366f6ec75138db167ed7f0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = Area of base × Height

⇒ 4800 = Area of base × 20

⇒ Area of base = 4800 ÷ 20

⇒ Area of base = 240 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 240 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total area of all six faces is given by 2(lb + bh + hl), where l, b, and h are length, breadth, and height.

Lateral Surface Area of Cuboid

The area of the four side walls (excluding top and bottom) is 2h(l + b).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboid is its diagonal, calculated as √(l² + b² + h²).</p
